title: HIPAA Breaches in 2025: HHS Portal Data Analysis
summary: HIPAA Breaches in 2025: HHS Portal Data Analysis: scope, evidence, limitations, and the decisions buyers need to make.
body_markdown:
## What does the entity breakdown mean for health-tech vendors?


Business-associate reports are one category, alongside providers, health plans, and clearinghouses. A supplier incident can also affect multiple customer reports, so the number of portal records is not the number of independent attack campaigns.


The[Security Rule summary](https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/security/laws-regulations/index.html) explains the safeguard framework. Use the data to prompt questions about information flows, supplier responsibilities, access, and incident coordination. It does not rank vendors or establish the return on buying a product.


## How can readers reproduce and reuse the result?


Download the aggregate CSV and review the methodology below. It explains the period filter, threshold, deduplication, and exclusions. The repository records hashes of the original exports and includes the aggregation script.


For operational planning, review[HIPAA services](https://getagency.com/frameworks/hipaa?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=hipaa&utm_content=hipaa-breaches-2025-hhs-analysis__in_text) and[HIPAA for startups](https://getagency.com/hipaa-for-startups?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=cta&utm_campaign=hipaa&utm_content=hipaa-breaches-2025-hhs-analysis__in_text) . A government dataset supplies context; the actual controls and responsibilities must follow your information and obligations.
